The '''Ansata system''' was a [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] [[Star system/Legends|star system]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was the origin point of<ref name="Planetnamia">{{Planetnamia|other=[[Ansata pattern/Legends|Ansata patterns]] and [[Ansata hair stick/Legends|Ansata hair sticks]]|system=Ansata [[Star system/Legends|system]]|legends=1}}</ref> [[Ansata pattern/Legends|Ansata patterns]]<ref name="Visual Dictionary">''[[Star Wars: Attack of the Clones: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> and [[Ansata hair stick/Legends|Ansata hair sticks]].<ref name="CWCharacterEncyclopedia">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Character Encyclopedia]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Ansata system was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], which placed the system in grid square M-11.<ref name="TEA" />
